supersedes_wording: K2_TWO_CAMERA_PARALLAX as if the two currently operational 4K Blue Box cameras formed a useful separated stereo pair.
finding: Project Hessdalen's current public documentation says the two operational Dahua cameras are attached to the same Blue Box mast and point west and south. Co-mounted cameras do not provide the surveyed spatial baseline required for useful long-range triangulation merely because an event appears in both fields of view.

public_station_state.third_camera_status_is_not_frozen: Public pages describe a third camera as being tested near Oyungen or planned/tested away from the Blue Box; exact operational status, position, clock discipline, overlap and calibration are not established in this pass.
public_station_state.historical_upper_station_context: Older Project Hessdalen documentation describes an upper camera station about 171 m from the Blue Box, but that legacy geometry must not be silently transferred to the 2024-2026 camera system.

requirements: At least two simultaneously operational cameras at distinct surveyed positions.
Overlapping field of view for the candidate event.
Clock offset and drift measured with uncertainty bounds.
Camera intrinsics and lens distortion calibrated.
Camera extrinsics/boresight orientation calibrated against stars or surveyed landmarks.
Candidate independently visible in raw frames from both stations.
Triangulation residual is physically consistent under uncertainty propagation.
replacement_gate.fail_closed: If any required stereo condition is missing, no distance, physical speed, altitude or local-atmosphere inference may be promoted from apparent angular motion alone.

lesson: TOPA must attack its own experimental design before attacking the anomaly.
